title: Senolytic Cocktail Dasatinib+Quercetin (D+Q) Does Not Enhance the ...
abstract: The study investigated the efficacy of the senolytic cocktail Dasatinib+Quercetin (D+Q) in combination with doxorubicin (DOX) for treating hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The research demonstrated that D+Q did not enhance the efficacy of doxorubicin in clearing doxorubicin-induced senescent HCC cells, both *in vitro* and *in vivo*. In fact, D+Q alone appeared to have pro-tumorigenic effects in control mice. The findings suggest that D+Q is ineffective, alone or in synergy with senescence-inducing chemotherapy, against experimental HCC.
